_comment: Core Keeper builds that shipped, newest first, canonical form: at least four segments, zero-padded. Starts at 0.6.3.0 because that is the build the Mod SDK shipped with -- no earlier version can carry a mod, so none can appear in CK_GAME_VERSION. Union of two sources, because neither is complete on its own: Steam's update feed (store events, type 12 and 14, titles in ENGLISH -- the localised ones carry different numbers) misses day-one hotfixes that never got their own post, and mod.io's Game Version tags miss builds nobody tagged. Refresh with utils/refresh_game_versions.py, which reports and does not write: the titles are hand-typed and contain errors.
